feature_contract.goal: Keep original game car-selector and menu DDS replacement graphics consistent with the first actual gamepad layout across desktop/VR gameplay, controller disconnect, reconnect and forced-pad transitions, without producing mixed/white UI art.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only UI controller-specific DDS pack selection and exact session identity; do not modify 3D scene textures, SkyGlow, R84 stereo transforms, original inputs/FFB, DX11 or frozen DXVK.
trace_stages: Original gamepad CurrentPadType/ForcedPadType selects the first known PC or console family during native replacement texture load.
HandleTexture resolves the original DDS hash, UI texture-pack ordinal and pad-specific optional directory with one immutable session owner.
The existing D3DX sprite and game R84 menu/car-select renderers consume a consistent DDS family; the Windows host CI executes actual portable reconnect/forced-source regression.
subcomponents: Freeze first valid gamepad family including PC-as-no-directory and preserve native forced preference on first selection.
Use the exact locked family at the live texture replacement directory resolver, with executable None/PC/Xbox/forced reconnect regressions in required host build.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Original car selector DDS path through session pad family and UI sprite source
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: First PC or console selection stays bound to a single UI pack even when forced/current pad changes during a later texture lookup.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Original game None/default texture path and unaffected scene XMT, input/FFB owner
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: None does not latch, first forced selection wins, PC uses no pad-specific directory, and scene cursor plus original controller input remain unchanged.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Windows x86 R84/R26 and x64 host executable regression with source-specific mandatory Gates
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Active/Domain/HUD/Full Source final exact-SHA Gates run and Windows host executes real session-pad regression; Quest3 runtime stays untested.

diagnosis.root_cause: HandleTexture stored padType only when non-PC, interpreting the valid first PC family as undecided. A later Xbox/PS attachment selected a pad-specific directory while current UI sprites still belonged to the PC pack.
diagnosis.original_evidence: src/hooks_textures.cpp contained an explicit developer TODO warning about Xbox-to-PC controller-disconnect texture corruption and the padType == nullptr guard did not latch initial PC.
source_trace: Game CurrentPadType/ForcedPadType observed at first UI-specific DDS hash lookup.
The mutable padType pointer was null both before selection and after a valid PC selection, allowing a later lookup to change family.
UI texture resolver probes multiple filesystem DDS replacement paths using padType, and game/UI sprite draws consume the chosen asset.
alternatives_rejected: No change to gamepad input or FFB, DDS pixels/alpha, 3D scene packs, or global renderer states; family is immutable only after actual known selection.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: This controls the source image family for car-selector/menu texture sprites across both R84 eye compositions; it does not assert corrected stereo eye placement without HMD evidence.

local_validation.planned: Exact SHA DX9Ex Active Windows x64 host smoke target outrun-vr-texture-pack-cursor-smoke.exe

next_action: Verify exact-SHA four mandatory Gates and host texture smoke; then C6-only bookkeeping if green. Quest3/VDXR remains UNTESTED.
